items.title: 3 US Insurer Stocks Whose Bond Portfolios Matter More at 5% Treasury Yields
items.summary: Bond-heavy US life and P&C insurers are suddenly back in the spotlight as 10-year and 30-year Treasury yields hover around two-decade highs near 5%. When the risk-free rate jumps, long-term portfolios and equity valuations both feel it, for better or worse. This article walks through three large insurers from our screener that appear closely tied to this rate shock and explains how their exposure might matter for your portfolio decisions.
